C0584.title: Douyin Store Miscategorization Leads to Tag Confusion and Low Ratings
C0584.summary: On Douyin stores, merchants who incorrectly list product categories can cause chaotic store tags, which in turn drag down store ratings. This is a common violation among new sellers, representing a typical case of category misplacement that misleads consumers and disrupts platform order.
